kurz: Hot pan, dry surface, little movement at the start: that is how a brown, aromatic crust forms.
bild_im_kopf: Like a rubber stamp: it needs firm, steady contact, or the print smudges.
was_passiert: The hot pan evaporates the last water on the surface; after that the temperature rises above 140 °C and browning begins. At first the meat sticks until a crust has formed, then it releases by itself. After that you may turn it more often, which even cooks it more evenly.
warum_wichtig: With quick-cooked meat, the crust supplies most of the flavour.
faustregeln: No sizzle means: the pan is too cold.
Better to fry in two batches than in one full pan.
schritte: Preheat the pan hard with a little heat-resistant oil.
Add the meat; it should sizzle loudly.
Leave it until it releases by itself.
Turn, cook to the desired [[kerntemperatur|core temperature]], and at the end add butter for [[arosieren|basting]].
